what: One browser reel, recorded twice by the same deterministic recipe (the recipe scripts/board-tape-gold.test.mjs uses): once on main's src (6f57e9ad2) and once on the cured tree. The reel's event-log hash must not move, because the standing's gold meaning is not inside it.
why: runTapeEventLogHash is taken over the event log only (src/game/RunTape.ts:276) and that log's `gold` field has always been `this.economy.gold` — the purse held. `outcome` sits OUTSIDE the hash, so changing what the reel DECLARES changes no tape.
recipe: pan >= 30 at the nearest live seam, step off, buy a beacon (spend 25), accelerate waves to the secure wave, bank
verdict: hash identical, durationTicks identical; the three gold figures move from the run's lifetime panning (30) to the purse held at the secure tick (5).
